standard-dialogue-before-starting-fight-.npc: Of course not! You have to be one of us, and you're clearly not. Now get out of here.

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-unlock-t.player: Hmm... It seems to be locked.

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-unlock-t.npc: Yeah, well spotted. You have to be one of us to go in there, and you're clearly not. Now get out of here.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-door-guard-.npc: Are you new? I've never seen you around here before.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-door-guard-.player: You could say that. Long live General Khazard!

standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-fi.npc: You're [him/her/them]! The one who murdered the General's pet. Leave this place at once!
